chapterInfo.content:
13
Aboa a ɔdi kan no
1 # Adi 11.7; 17.3; 17.9; 17.12; Dan 7.7 Na mehunuu aboa bi a ɔwɔ mmɛn du, ɛne tire nson sɛ ɔfiri po mu sɔreeɛ, na ahemmotire du bobɔ ne mmɛn, na abusudin wowɔ ne tiri ho. 2#Adi 12.3 Na aboa a mehunuu no no te sɛ ɔsebɔ, na ne nan te sɛ osisire nan, na n’ano te sɛ gyata ano. Na ɔtweaseɛ no de n’ahoɔden ne n’ahennwa ne ne tumi kɛseɛ maa no. 3#Adi 17.8 Na mehunuu sɛ ne tire no mu baako te sɛdeɛ wɔabɔ no bɔtorɔ, na wɔasa ne pira no, na aboa no ho yɛɛ wiasefoɔ nyinaa nwanwa maa wɔdii n’akyi. 4Na wɔkotoo ɔtweaseɛ no sɛ ɔde tumi ama aboa no, na wɔkotoo aboa no kaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔte sɛ aboa no? Na hwan na ɔbɛtumi ne no ako? 5#Dan 7.8; Adi 11.2; 12.6; 12.14 Na wɔmaa no ano a ɔde kaa nsɛm akɛseɛ ne abususɛm, na wɔmaa no kwan abosome aduanan mmienu. 6Na ɔbuee n’ano kaa abususɛm tiaa Onyankopɔn, sɛ ɔbɛka ne din ne ne ntomadan ne wɔn a wɔtete soro ho abususɛm. 7#Adi 11.7; Dan 7.21 Na wɔmaa no kwan sɛ ɔntu ahotefoɔ so sa, na ɔnni wɔn so nkonim. Na wɔmaa no mmusuakuo ne nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa ahodoɔ ne aman nyinaa so tumi. 8#Adi 12.12; 3.5; 17.8 Na wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ nyinaa bɛkoto no, wɔn a wɔamfiri wiase asehyɛ antwerɛ wɔn din Adwammaa a wɔkumm no no nkwa nwoma mu no.
9Sɛ obi wɔ aso a, ma no ntie.
10 # Mat 26.52; Adi 14.12 Sɛ obi fa nnommum a,
wɔbɛfa no dommum.
Sɛ obi de nkrantɛ kum a,
ɛtwa sɛ wɔde nkrantɛ ku no.
Ɛha na ahotefoɔ boasetɔ ne gyidie wɔ.
11 # Adi 16.13; Mat 7.15 Na mehunuu aboa foforɔ bi a ɔfiri asase mu baeɛ, na ɔwɔ mmɛn mmienu sɛ adwammaa, na ɔkasa sɛ ɔtweaseɛ. 12#Adi 13.12; 13.4-5; 13.7 Na ɔyɛ aboa a ɔdi kan no ahoɔdenneɛ nyinaa wɔ n’anim, na ɔma asase ne wɔn a wɔtete soɔ koto aboa a ɔdi kan a wɔasa ne wuopira no. 13#Mat 24.24; 2 Te 2.9-10; 1 Ah 18.24-39 Na ɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ akɛseɛ, na ɔma ogya mpo firi soro ba asase so, nnipa anim. 14#Deut 13.1-3 Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔde maa no sɛ ɔnyɛ no aboa no anim nti, ɔdaadaa wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ no, ka kyerɛɛ asase sotefoɔ no sɛ, wɔnyɛ ohoni mma aboa a nkrantɛ apira no na ɔte ase bio no. 15Na wɔmaa no kwan sɛ ɔmma aboa no honi no honhom, na aboa no honi no mpo akasa, na wama wɔakum dodoɔ a wɔnkoto aboa no honi no. 16#Adi 19.20 Na ɔma nketewa ne akɛseɛ, adefoɔ ne ahiafoɔ, adehyeɛ ne nkoa nyinaa pene ma wɔhyɛ wɔn agyiraeɛ, wɔn nsa nifa anaa wɔn moma so, 17nanso obi ntumi ntɔ anaasɛ ɔntɔn, gye deɛ ɔwɔ agyiraeɛ no, anaa aboa no din, anaa ne din akonta ntwerɛeɛ nko.
18 # Adi 17.9; 15.2 Ɛha na wɔhwehwɛ nyansa. Deɛ ɔwɔ nteaseɛ mmu aboa no akonta no ntoano, na ɛyɛ onipa akonta ntoano, na n’akonta ntoano yɛ ahansia aduosia nsia.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na mehunuu aboa bi a ɔwɔ mmɛn du, ɛne tire nson sɛ ɔfiri po mu sɔreeɛ, na ahemmotire du bobɔ ne mmɛn, na abusudin wowɔ ne tiri ho. Na aboa a mehunuu no no te sɛ ɔsebɔ, na ne nan te sɛ osisire nan, na n’ano te sɛ gyata ano. Na ɔtweaseɛ no de n’ahoɔden ne n’ahennwa ne ne tumi kɛseɛ maa no. Na mehunuu sɛ ne tire no mu baako te sɛdeɛ wɔabɔ no bɔtorɔ, na wɔasa ne pira no, na aboa no ho yɛɛ wiasefoɔ nyinaa nwanwa maa wɔdii n’akyi. Na wɔkotoo ɔtweaseɛ no sɛ ɔde tumi ama aboa no, na wɔkotoo aboa no kaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔte sɛ aboa no? Na hwan na ɔbɛtumi ne no ako? Na wɔmaa no ano a ɔde kaa nsɛm akɛseɛ ne abususɛm, na wɔmaa no kwan abosome aduanan mmienu. Na ɔbuee n’ano kaa abususɛm tiaa Onyankopɔn, sɛ ɔbɛka ne din ne ne ntomadan ne wɔn a wɔtete soro ho abususɛm. Na wɔmaa no kwan sɛ ɔntu ahotefoɔ so sa, na ɔnni wɔn so nkonim. Na wɔmaa no mmusuakuo ne nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa ahodoɔ ne aman nyinaa so tumi. Na wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ nyinaa bɛkoto no, wɔn a wɔamfiri wiase asehyɛ antwerɛ wɔn din Adwammaa a wɔkumm no no nkwa nwoma mu no.
Sɛ obi wɔ aso a, ma no ntie.
Sɛ obi fa nnommum a,
wɔbɛfa no dommum.
Sɛ obi de nkrantɛ kum a,
ɛtwa sɛ wɔde nkrantɛ ku no.
Ɛha na ahotefoɔ boasetɔ ne gyidie wɔ.
Na mehunuu aboa foforɔ bi a ɔfiri asase mu baeɛ, na ɔwɔ mmɛn mmienu sɛ adwammaa, na ɔkasa sɛ ɔtweaseɛ. Na ɔyɛ aboa a ɔdi kan no ahoɔdenneɛ nyinaa wɔ n’anim, na ɔma asase ne wɔn a wɔtete soɔ koto aboa a ɔdi kan a wɔasa ne wuopira no. Na ɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ akɛseɛ, na ɔma ogya mpo firi soro ba asase so, nnipa anim. Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a wɔde maa no sɛ ɔnyɛ no aboa no anim nti, ɔdaadaa wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ no, ka kyerɛɛ asase sotefoɔ no sɛ, wɔnyɛ ohoni mma aboa a nkrantɛ apira no na ɔte ase bio no. Na wɔmaa no kwan sɛ ɔmma aboa no honi no honhom, na aboa no honi no mpo akasa, na wama wɔakum dodoɔ a wɔnkoto aboa no honi no. Na ɔma nketewa ne akɛseɛ, adefoɔ ne ahiafoɔ, adehyeɛ ne nkoa nyinaa pene ma wɔhyɛ wɔn agyiraeɛ, wɔn nsa nifa anaa wɔn moma so, nanso obi ntumi ntɔ anaasɛ ɔntɔn, gye deɛ ɔwɔ agyiraeɛ no, anaa aboa no din, anaa ne din akonta ntwerɛeɛ nko.
Ɛha na wɔhwehwɛ nyansa. Deɛ ɔwɔ nteaseɛ mmu aboa no akonta no ntoano, na ɛyɛ onipa akonta ntoano, na n’akonta ntoano yɛ ahansia aduosia nsia.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
